events.title: Symfony framework released
events.summary: Fabien Potencier open sourced Symfony — a PHP web framework that later split into reusable components.
events.about: Symfony is a PHP framework for full web applications — routing, forms, security, ORM. Its bigger legacy: standalone components (HTTP, console, DI) reused by Laravel, Drupal 8+, and others. Typical Symfony apps: enterprise portals, APIs, and multi-module business software in PHP.

narrative.whyChosen: Symfony's component strategy reshaped PHP: frameworks could share HttpFoundation, Console, and DI instead of reinventing them.
narrative.whyImportant: Laravel, Drupal, and others built on Symfony components, creating a shared PHP infrastructure layer.
narrative.problemSolved: PHP projects duplicated request handling, routing, and bootstrapping code across every framework.

events.title: Arduino boards first shipped
events.summary: The Arduino team began shipping the first Arduino boards in October 2005 — an open-source microcontroller platform for hobbyists and makers.
events.about: Arduino boards run sketches in C-like Wiring on AVR microcontrollers — blink LEDs, read sensors, drive motors with a USB cable and no OS. Makers, educators, and IoT prototypes used it before Raspberry Pi brought full Linux to the same audience. The IDE and shield ecosystem made embedded programming accessible without a EE degree.

narrative.whyChosen: Arduino democratized microcontroller programming for non-specialists.
narrative.whyImportant: It launched the modern maker movement and influenced IoT prototyping worldwide.
narrative.problemSolved: Embedded development required expensive tools and proprietary toolchains out of reach for hobbyists.
